always-long.convention: per symbol per fold: hold from first non-jump bar open to last bar close, side=±1, roundtrip cost deducted; retBps = side*(exit-entry)/entry*1e4 - roundtripBps/legs

always-short.convention: per symbol per fold: hold from first non-jump bar open to last bar close, side=±1, roundtrip cost deducted; retBps = side*(exit-entry)/entry*1e4 - roundtripBps/legs

random.convention: same entry bars as strategy; direction and stop/target mirrored around the actual entry price; dynamic manage() exits not mirrored (fixed-price brackets used)

always-long.convention: market baseline in bps converted to pseudo-R via strategy median relative initial-risk distance (|entry-stop|/entry)

always-short.convention: market baseline in bps converted to pseudo-R via strategy median relative initial-risk distance (|entry-stop|/entry)
